description.value:
Your raw physical power seems to radiate from you, drawing attention wherever you go. Your Strength score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You may substitute your Strength modifier for your Constitution modifier whenever you make a Constitution check, and you may likewise substitute a Strength saving throw for a Constitution saving throw. You can use this substitution a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all spent uses whenever you finish a long rest.
